motion.cited: a lit face goes from lit to dark within 0.2 s, so the light follows the pointer with a 0.05 s lag (95% of a move in 0.15 s)

beats: A paper stamp lies among paper scraps on a desk. Its printed area is an embossed relief of ripple rings, screened as one-ink halftone dots after the light; its pale paper margin carries the title and issue line, printed solid
The pointer sets the light: the light comes from the cursor's side, so the ring faces turned toward the cursor light up and the stamp's shadow falls away from the cursor (the owner, look review)
The rings' lit faces bloom into larger light dots, and the faces turned away fall back to bare ink
The stamp has its own tone against the desk, stands raised on it and casts a shadow that turns as the light turns; the scraps cast their own small shadows
The desk paper's gentle warp drifts slowly (the sheet field's own drift); nothing else moves without the pointer
